summary: Defines the pseudo-random function for the Kerberos V mechanism of GSS-API, based on the PRF in the Kerberos V cryptographic framework. It is used to key application protocols once a Kerberos security context is established. It is now historic and was replaced by RFC 7802.

eli5.summary: Once two programs have shown their Kerberos ID, this tells them how to cook up fresh secret keys from it. It has since been replaced.
